answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using proof-of-space-time. To register, an agent stores a large, incompressible plot seeded by its key and a canonical string like a sonnet, then answers fast Merkle challenges. This stops cheap clones from shifting like a dune, sustaining an audited orchard of committed nodes. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of dedicating scarce physical disk capacity per identity. However, operators with surplus storage can still fund multiple identities.
